issue_context.title: Add an EVP demo for HKDF
issue_context.body: It should be the current best practice (fetch), have proper error handling and resource allocation/deallocation and be in the style of a known answer test.

review_comments: A comment saying what HKDF is/does might be useful.
Comments explaining each step would be better again.

I added the kdf entry in the [README.md](https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/15784/files#diff-c6ec795ee57468b7429abb6a588dd5d1e9169c080399b325751df19549c33fecR22) and also commented the important pieces in the code.
"SHA265" instead of SN_SHA256 for the demos.
